about: Test data for shipd.ts. reference: hull vectors from the Ship-D dataset (Bagazinski and Ahmed 2023, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/MMGAUS, CC0 1.0) with the values the original HullParameterization.py (github.com/noahbagz/C_ShipGen, MIT) gives for them: the 49 constraints, waterline points (every sixth of 120, at full precision) at a set of heights, and its own volume measures at the design waterline. three edge cases made from them (a stern bulb nearly as wide as the hull, bulbs with a negative keel radius, a zero keel radius the original cannot build). The example hulls the tests also use are in ../catalogue.json.
